issue_context.title: roachtest: add Hibernate nightly roachtest for version 6.x
issue_context.body:
Our Hibernate test is pinned to version 5.6.15
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/5eb4a53a0d1e6d2c9e49c4382f931e98bbe0968d/pkg/cmd/roachtest/tests/hibernate.go#L26

We need to also add another test for Hibernate 6.x and assess what fails. CRDB is already running on the main Hibernate repo so nothing should break but we still need to verify. Both 5.6 and 6.x are supported by Hibernate so we should have both tests.

context in https://cockroachlabs.slack.com/archives/CPD3ANLMB/p1695856646208149

Jira issue: CRDB-31885

review_comments:
1. Yeah I think it makes sense to pull the version from each release branch. I'll be backporting this PR eventually so `release-22.2` and `release-23.1` should be updated soon.

2. We can keep the min version for now until we find a reason we need to bump it higher.
Thanks. Raised https://github.com/cockroachdb/docs/pull/18018 and requested a quick review from my team.
The docs PR https://github.com/cockroachdb/docs/pull/18018 has been merged and deployed, so we are good to merge your PR, @andyyang890. Thanks for your patience.
